Thanks Aisha — great questions. Quick answers and clarifications: 

• SOC 2 / Pen test: Attached is our SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). We can provide the full SOC 2 report under an NDA if needed; our most recent penetration test summary is included in the SOC packet.

• Staging access: For the initial intake we typically ask for screenshots/configs and a read-only staging account only if reproducing an environment-specific issue is necessary. We do not need write access.

• Logs & retention: Default request-log retention is 90 days for hosted customers; we offer custom retention options for enterprise (can be 1 year+ with dedicated storage). We provide request logs and access logs via our console and can arrange a secure export if you need an audit bundle.

Stakeholder confirmations:
- Economic buyer: Rajesh — confirmed?
- Security owner: Aisha — confirmed?
- Procurement/Legal: Tom — any specific PO / contract timeline we should be aware of?

Next steps:
1) I'll send the calendar invite for Tue 9 Jun 10:00 PT (invite includes a short agenda).
2) Neha will review the attached questionnaire and send an evidence request list within 48 hours after the kickoff.
3) If you want the full SOC 2 report now, we can kick off an NDA; otherwise we'll bring the SOC summary to the call.

Let me know if you want to narrow scope to production-only.

—Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Quick procurement/contract questions from our side before the kickoff: 

1) Contracting: Do you use a standard MSA? Any non-negotiables we should flag in advance (data residency, indemnity, liability caps)?
